div.p: Train under a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer to add one of the world's most evidence-backed somatic tools to your practice. Three modules — from personal practice to certified provider.

img.alt: Become a Certified TRE™ Provider — module dates and 2026 pricing poster

figure.figcaption: Tap the poster to view full size

div.h2: Why TRE™ Is Worth Certifying In
div.p: TRE™ (Tension, Stress & Trauma Releasing Exercises) activates the body's natural neurogenic tremoring response — a reflex that releases stored stress and trauma from the nervous system. Developed by Dr. David Berceli and backed by 40+ years of research, it is used with PTSD, chronic stress and general wellness populations across 100+ countries.
Unlike many modalities, TRE™ can be taught to clients for independent practice — making it a high-value, scalable addition to any practitioner's toolkit.

ul.li: Coaches (executive, life, wellness) wanting somatic tools
Therapists, counsellors and psychologists seeking body-based approaches
HR and OD professionals in corporate wellness and resilience
Physiotherapists, yoga teachers and movement practitioners
Anyone working in trauma support, conflict resolution or post-crisis recovery
Practitioners who have experienced TRE™ personally and want to share it

div.p: Three modules — each a 2-day workshop plus online sessions — take you from personal practice to Certified Global TRE™ Provider.

div.strong: Module 1 — Your Personal TRE™ Practice · 29–30 Aug 2026
div.p: 2-day workshop + 4 online personal TRE™ sessions. Explore the stress response, understand the therapeutic tremor response, and experience TRE™ as a self-practice — including self-regulation, containment and grounding strategies. The first step for anyone keen to pursue the certification path. 21 ICF CCEUs included.

div.strong: Module 2 — Teaching TRE™ to One Person · 26–27 Sep 2026
div.p: 2-day workshop + 4 online supervision sessions. Open to those who have completed Module 1. Deepens Module 1 content, covers Polyvagal theory and basic TRE™ interventions, with hands-on practice teaching TRE™ one-to-one.

div.strong: Module 3 — Teaching TRE™ to Groups · 20–21 Feb 2027
div.p: 2-day workshop + 4 online supervision sessions. Open to those who have completed all Module 2 requirements. Covers advanced TRE™ interventions, the role of fascia, transference and counter-transference, and experience leading groups of 3+ persons.

On completing all three modules you receive your Global TRE™ Provider certificate — qualified to offer TRE™ to the public in individual and group settings, and to competently guide clients through the TRE™ process.

ul.li: Access to TRE™ for All global community
Certificate issued by TRE™ for All

div.p: All prices in Singapore Dollars. Previous Module 1 payments are deductible from the full bundle price.

div.div: Super early bird — 8+ weeks before Module 1

div.p: Module 1 only (in-person): S$1,290 ICF Special / S$1,500 Early Bird / S$1,800 Normal · Module 1 only (online): S$990 Early Bird / S$1,190 Normal

div.h2: Learning From a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer

div.span: Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · ICF PCC
div.p: Accredited by TRE™ for All under Dr. David Berceli's methodology — the highest level of qualification to certify new TRE™ Providers worldwide. Over 30 years of human development experience and somatic practice, training practitioners across Europe, Asia, the US and beyond.
The 2026 Singapore intake is closed. The 2027 Singapore cohort opens with Module 1 on 24–25 April 2027 (early bird until 31 March 2027).

div.strong: Joining online? Prepare your space first.
div.span: Camera positioning, what to bring, lighting, dress code and joining on Zoom — everything to set up before your online TRE™ session.

div.h2: Ready to Add TRE™ to Your Practice?
div.p: Spaces are limited in each certification cohort. Contact Isabelle to confirm your place.
